# sonarqube_webhook (Resource)

A global or project webhook. Import ID: `key` or `key/project`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A global webhook. secret_wo keeps the signing secret out of state
# (Terraform 1.11+); change secret_wo_version to apply a new one.
resource "sonarqube_webhook" "ci" {
  name              = "ci"
  url               = "https://ci.example.com/sonarqube/webhook"
  secret_wo         = var.webhook_secret
  secret_wo_version = "1"
}

# A project webhook.
resource "sonarqube_webhook" "api" {
  name    = "api-deploy"
  url     = "https://deploy.example.com/hooks/sonarqube"
  project = "example-api"
}

variable "webhook_secret" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Webhook name.
- `url` (String) Endpoint receiving the payload.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `project` (String) Project key for a project webhook.
- `secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret used to sign payloads (HMAC-SHA256), 16 to 200 characters. SonarQube does not return it, so only its presence is checked. Removing it from the configuration removes it from the webhook.
- `secret_wo` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments)) Write-only secret, never stored in state (Terraform 1.11+). Change `secret_wo_version` to apply a new one.
- `secret_wo_version` (String) Any value; changing it applies the current `secret_wo`. Removing `secret_wo` and this removes the secret.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of this resource in Terraform state.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import sonarqube_webhook.example 'AY1234567890abcdef'
```
